questions.question: Why does God say he refines and acts for his people in Isaiah 48?
options: For his own name's sake, that it not be profaned
In return for their many sacrifices
Because of their strength in battle
Because of their righteousness and obedience
questions.answer: For his own name's sake, that it not be profaned

questions.question: What does God lament his people did not do in Isaiah 48?
options: Send word to the king of Egypt for the help that they so badly needed
Pay attention to his commandments, or peace would have been like a river
Build back up the broken-down walls of the city before the enemy returned
Offer up enough sacrifices and keep enough feasts at the temple of the LORD
questions.answer: Pay attention to his commandments, or peace would have been like a river

questions.question: Isaiah 48 ends saying there is no peace for the wicked.
Oh that you had paid attention to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a _____.
Go out from Babylon, flee from Chaldea... say, 'The LORD has redeemed his servant _____!'
